verdict.rationale: Pilot is a bookkeeping, tax and CFO service with a customer portal and AI answers, so asking whether users can opt out of usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control, so the applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
